answer: Make every identity rent a slice of real time. Each epoch the network publishes a fresh seed, and every agent must return a verifiable delay proof on it: about an hour of strictly sequential computing, checked in seconds. One honest agent spends one core-hour per epoch; a farm of a thousand keys needs a thousand cores running nonstop, since the work cannot be split or done ahead. Like boats at a jetty, each key waits its own turn. No forge mints a shortcut, so a farm's cost climbs toward its zenith exactly as fast as its key count.
